status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.
scope: Merge the supplied FTO 1L3T edits, regenerate the application data bundle, validate the result, then publish the approved changes.
assumptions: For matching case IDs, apply only algorithms, scramble, and tags.recognition from the supplied cases.
Preserve case identity, names, groups, SVG references, existing scrambles metadata, and unrelated tags.

tasks.title: Validate supplied 1L3T edits
tasks.summary: Confirm the supplied JSON structure and case IDs before changing source data.
verify: Confirm every supplied ID exists exactly once in the source.

tasks.title: Merge supplied 1L3T case edits
tasks.summary: Apply supplied algorithms, scramble, and recognition values only to matching cases.
verify: Confirm all supplied IDs were updated.

tasks.title: Regenerate and validate application data
tasks.summary: Rebuild the app data bundle and validate source and generated data.

tasks.title: Commit and push approved changes
tasks.summary: Commit the completed JSON update and its generated bundle, then publish to GitHub.
